# shopify_publication (Data Source)

Reads a sales channel publication by name, for example to reference its ID. Publications belong to sales channel apps and are not managed by this provider. Publications have no handle, so the name is the key; it differs per store for headless channels. Fails if no publication has the name, and lists the names that exist. Fails if several publications share the name. Needs the `read_publications` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A sales channel publication owned by an app, which this provider doesn't manage.
data "shopify_publication" "online_store" {
  name = "Online Store"
}

output "online_store_publication_id" {
  value = data.shopify_publication.online_store.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the publication, e.g. `Online Store`. Matched exactly, including case.

### Read-Only

- `auto_publish` (Boolean) Whether new products are published to this publication automatically.
- `catalog_id` (String) GID of the catalog the publication belongs to (an app catalog for sales channels). Null if there is none.
- `id` (String) Publication GID.
